tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Confirmed, per CNBC: Microsoft to sell $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra containing Nvidia AI chip.
Confirmed, per The Decoder: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over.
Reported by CNBC: Anthropic unveils a new, cheaper Haiku model.
Reported by Cyber Press: GitHub Copilot CLI Flaw Uses Encrypted Prompts to Leak Developer Secrets in Autopilot Mode.
Confirmed, per Yahoo! Finance Canada: McDonald’s sued over AI pricing tool in proposed antitrust class action.
